$comment: Dependency manifest for the DuckDB community-extensions build.
Their CI provides a pinned vcpkg and sets VCPKG_TOOLCHAIN_PATH, so every
third-party library must be declared here rather than found on the system.
vtk-minimal is our own overlay port (vcpkg_ports/vtk-minimal). vcpkg's
official `vtk` port is unusable here: its portfile HARDCODES
VTK_GROUP_ENABLE_Rendering=YES with no feature to turn it off, and carries 26
base manifest entries including glew, gl2ps and freetype, plus a second
VTK-derived host build (vtk-compile-tools). Qt is an opt-in feature there, not
a default dependency — an earlier version of this note said otherwise.
See that port's vcpkg.json for the full reasoning.
name: duck-vtk
